why.title: Why I do what I do
paragraphs: I wrote my first hello world in 2016. For a long time, I didn't know exactly what I wanted to do—which led me to try a lot of things: graphic design, running my own printing store, and a few other side quests.

A decade later, one thing has stayed consistent: I get real satisfaction when I spot a problem, have an idea for solving it, and learn whatever skills it takes to bring that idea to life. Done that, for myself, for the government, and for startups  [Interna, Celia, Zynta, and Devtranet.]

With Neurosync, I get to research on a frontier technology. I do what I do because I wake up every day imagining what the world might look like in another decade—and it excites me that I chose this path.
